text:
sam: Quick heads-up 98 10 — vuln scanner flagged admin KMS access for a pipeline SA in analytics-prod (`etl@analytics-prod`). Scanner link: https://redwood.internal/sec/vuln/5678

clare: saw that. the finding shows `roles/kms.cryptoOperator` granted to the SA. that gives decrypt/cryptokey use. when was the grant applied?

nate: looks like it was applied 2026-01-12 via CI. i can pull exact iam binding. command i used: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy analytics-prod --flatten="bindings[]" --filter="bindings.members:serviceAccount:etl@analytics-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --format=json`

eli: also check the key-level binding in keyring-prod: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/keyring-prod/locations/global/keyRings/kr1/cryptoKeys/etl-key --format=json` 

jenna: do not revoke yet. we need to map decrypt consumers first (cron jobs, airflow tasks, and any export lambdas). blind removal will break nightly ETL.

sam: proposal: (1) inventory SA -> project & KMS grants; (2) run policy simulator / staging deny canary; (3) owner notif window (72h) then apply scoped least-priv or key-split.

clare: add step: annotate inventory with last_seen, deployment pipeline ref, and linked secrets. ping owners with template.

audit-bot: ALERT: org access-review policy requires 72h owner notification before removing admin/key grants. See ticket #6789.

nate: i'll run the policy simulator: `gcloud iam policies simulate --principal=serviceAccount:etl@analytics-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --condition='deny kms.keys.decrypt'` and produce an impact CSV. ETA 2h.

eli: if consumers need decrypt we should create a dedicated key per service or use a constrained role. recommend `roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator` -> split to key-specific bindings.

jenna: file an infra retention note too: missing longer-tail logs make audits noisy. raised infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/retention/890 to extend admin log retention to 365d.

sam: i'll start inventory now and post CSV to the PR. also grep scheduler and secret-manager accesses: `gcloud scheduler jobs list --project=analytics-prod` and `gcloud secrets versions access`.

clare: ping template draft: "We've identified admin-level KMS access for <sa>. We're planning a staged restriction to least-priv on <date>. Please reply within 72h if you require continued decrypt access. Reply with a short justification and owner contact." add :eyes: and link to rollback runbook.

nate: include rollback commands in runbook: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding ... --member=serviceAccount:... --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoOperator` and a one-click re-enable play.

eli: also log this as a vulnerability triage item so risk scoring reflects potential availability impact.

jenna: tagging ops-oncall for rapid revert contact if canary fails: @ops-oncall

sam: posting first inventory CSV in 90m. will flag any keys with cross-project grants.

clare: thanks. tagging thread `audit:rbac-kms-tightening` and i'll open the PR with the owner pings and canary playbook once CSV is up. :lock:

audit-bot: NOTICE: follow-up check scheduled in 72h to verify owner responses and action progress.
